name: 習慣の開始日と時刻と通知
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: LH13-0019「習慣の開始日と時刻と通知」. ONE compact two-row scheduling-and-notification settings card, close framed on pure white.
Reference hierarchy: Image1 ORIGINAL Finch controls icon geometry, stroke/optical weight, dropdown controls, arrangement and OFF switch state. Scope ONLY logical x18,y354,w354,h122. Image2 mock SECONDARY for Japanese wording/type/layout; it omits BOTH source dropdown chevrons, restore them. Images3/4 original calendar-clock and bell crops govern exact glyph details, neutralize their decorative colored fills. Image5 bus is STYLE ONLY.
One white rounded card with subtle neutral border/soft shadow,18px logical corners. Upper row: small original calendar-grid-with-clock glyph in coherent slate#526173 on neutral small circle at left; beside it two-column setting block. Left column exact small label「開始日」above「今日・8月27日」with one down-chevron after the value. A short thin vertical divider separates the right column: exact small label「時間」above「いつでも」with its own down-chevron on far right. Keep both dropdown chevrons visible and source-shaped, never omit. Horizontal thin divider across card separates lower row. Lower row: original bell glyph in slate on small neutral circular field at left, exact Japanese「この習慣を知らせる」, single OFF switch aligned right; neutral gray track and white thumb LEFT. No green ON state, extra time selector, extra calendar, field, date or metric.
Typography from native locked: both small labels Meiryo Regular12px/16px; values and notification text Meiryo Regular14px/24px; tracking0. Ink#1D1D1D, secondary labels#6E6E6E. Keep all text regular, not bold. Compact readable spacing; grow height minimally if necessary rather than clip. Original green calendar and yellow bell backgrounds decorate settings categories, not state; use coherent slate/neutral, no multicolor icons. No primary action in scope, no forced brand green, no broad mint. Pure white canvas/card, no other settings/header/save/close, heavy glow, device frame or watermark. Preserve source actual content and OFF state. Raster design candidate.
reviewNotes: Japanese labels/values inspected, TodayAug27 and anytime retained; BOTH omitted dropdown chevrons restored, original calendar-clock/bell silhouettes retained in coherent slate. Vertical/horizontal dividers and OFF switch left-thumb state correct. Decorative green/yellow badges adapted to neutral, white surfaces/fine border. No extra controls. Exact source pixels/native typography and actual selectors/toggle unproved.
